title: NEBNext® Ultra™ II DNA Library Prep Kit for Illumina®
author: Opentrons
materials: NEBNext® Ultra™ II DNA Library Prep Kit

This protocol automates the [NEBNext® Ultra™ II DNA Library Prep Kit for Illumina®](https://www.neb.com/products/e7645-nebnext-ultra-ii-dna-library-prep-kit-for-illumina#Product%20Information) on the OT-2. This protocol was developed internally by Opentrons for use on the OT-2 and provides several options. Users can select how many samples to prepare, whether or not to use on-deck modules (like our thermocycler), and whether or not to perform certain steps in the process. Additionally, users can select to enable a "Test Mode" that is great for performing a dry run of the protocol. For a more detailed explanation of this protocol, including deck setup and reagent setup, please see this guide: [link to guide](https://opentrons-protocol-library-website.s3.amazonaws.com/custom-README-images/sci-neb-next-ultra/NEBNext+Ultra+II+-+Protocol+Library+Readme.pdf) Explanation of complex parameters below: * **Number of Samples**: Select the number of samples to prepare * **Test Mode (dry run)**: Select whether to perform a dry run (Yes) instead of a sample run * **Use Modules**: Select whether or not you are using our Magnetic Module (GEN2)](https://shop.opentrons.com/collections/hardware-modules/products/magdeck) and [Temperature Module (GEN2)](https://shop.opentrons.com/collections/hardware-modules/products/tempdeck) * **Reuse Tips**: Select whether or not to reuse tips for certain steps (selecting yes will reuse tips in a sterile way, saving on the amount of tips used and eliminating the need to replace tips during the run) * **Use Thermocycler**: Select whether or not you will use our on-deck GEN1 thermocycler module. If not using (select "No"), the user will be prompted to move the sample plate to an off-deck thermocycler. * **Use Opentrons Offsets**: Select whether to use Z offsets used by the Opentrons Science Team ("Yes") or use the default Z heights of the labware ("No") * **Perform ERAT Step**: Select whether or not to perform the ERAT step. * **Perform Ligation Step**

steps.title: Enter protocol parameters
steps.instruction: Select the desired options: number of samples, Test Mode (Yes/No), Use Modules (Magnetic Module GEN2, Temperature Module GEN2), Reuse Tips (Yes/No), Use Thermocycler (GEN1) (Yes/No), Use Opentrons Offsets (Yes/No), Perform ERAT Step (Yes/No), Perform Ligation Step (Yes/No).

steps.title: Download protocol file
steps.instruction: Click the download button to obtain the generated Python (.py) protocol file.

steps.title: Upload protocol to OT App
steps.instruction: In the OT App, go to the Protocol tab and upload the downloaded .py file.

steps.title: Arrange deck according to map
steps.instruction: Place labware, tip racks, and modules on the OT‑2 deck as shown in the provided deck map.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Using the OT App, perform calibration of all labware, tip racks, and the pipette; refer to support articles for guidance.

steps.title: Start the protocol
steps.instruction: Press ‘Run’ in the OT App to execute the protocol.
